name: DocumentProjection
documentation:
Configures the direct current-state document maintained by a {@link Model} whose
 {@link Model#persistence() persistence} stores a document.

methods.name: collection
methods.documentation: Collection receiving current Model documents. Blank defaults to the Model's simple class name.

methods.name: endPath
methods.documentation: Optional property path used as the document's end timestamp.

methods.name: searchable
methods.documentation:
Whether this current document is exposed through the Model's public search collection.

When {@code false}, Fluxzero does not expose the document through an unrestricted typed Model search. The direct document remains in {@link #collection() its normal resolved collection}. A Model without a separate Graph role is stored without a text summary, facets or sortable indexes and remains available through direct Model loads, aliases and exact parent or ancestor relationships. A Model that participates in Graph composition still maintains its independently required internal component indexes; use {@link io.fluxzero.common.search.SearchExclude @SearchExclude}, {@code @Facet} and {@code @Sortable} to shape those indexes explicitly.

methods.name: timestampPath
methods.documentation: Optional property path used as the document's start timestamp.
